verdict.rationale: Hands-on reports confirm developers can quickly create a free-tier Gemini API key self-serve, with no sales call. Google's docs promise a first API call in under a minute and reference using 'your Gemini API key', but no item quotes the actual key-creation steps. The comment about account friction is general perception, not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: a first-party doc excerpt explicitly describing the sign-up and key-minting steps (e.g. in AI Studio), and confirmation that no waitlist or approval gate applies.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign up and mint an API key self-serve — no sales call, no waitlist gymnastics — and the docs say exactly how

citations.quote: You'll make your first API call in under a minute
Bunun için üç satır kodu güncellemeniz ve Gemini API anahtarınızı kullanmanız gerekir.
They absolutely deserve credit for their free tier API keys though.
I had quickly created an API key during a live Google training session.
